name: menu-show-delay-zero
title: Zero Delay Menus
description: Removes the small wait before Windows menus open. This does not change in-game input delay.
deepDescription:
WHAT IT CHANGES
Sets the current Windows user's MenuShowDelay value to 0 ms so context menus and other Windows menus open without their usual animation delay.

SCOPE
This affects Windows menus only. It does not change keyboard or mouse polling, game input latency, network ping, or hit registration.

UNDO
Restores the common Windows default of 400 ms.
